jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

 **Primary Responsibilities:**

* Product Strategy, Vision \& Delivery
	+ Define and execute product strategy for AI\-powered payer solutions, including agentic platforms and automation use cases
	+ Translate complex payer business problems (benefits, pricing, policy, prior auth) into scalable AI product capabilities
	+ Develop and maintain a prioritized roadmap aligned to measurable business outcomes (e.g., cost savings, denial reduction, operational efficiency)
	+ Drive portfolio\-level prioritization balancing innovation, scalability, and speed to market
* End\-to\-End Product Lifecycle
	+ Support the full product lifecycle from concept through Alpha, Beta, and General Availability (GA)
	+ Define MVP scope, success criteria, and acceptance criteria for AI\-driven capabilities
	+ Support backlog creation, refinement, and prioritization using Agile frameworks (Rally/Aha)
	+ Partner with engineering and data science teams to deliver high\-quality, scalable solutions
* Cross\-Functional Leadership \& Stakeholder Engagement
	+ Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including engineering, data science, operations, compliance, and clinical stakeholders
	+ Partner with external organizations to align on product delivery and technical capabilities
	+ Support and lead executive communications, product reviews, and cross\-team alignment to ensure delivery success
	+ Act as product SME to support sales enablement and customer engagement
* Customer \& Market Alignment
	+ Engage with payer clients to validate use cases and ensure alignment with real\-world workflows
	+ Incorporate regulatory and operational requirements into product design
	+ Develop customer\-facing materials to support go\-to\-market readiness and adoption
* Performance Measurement \& Outcomes
	+ Define and track KPIs tied to business value (e.g., cost reduction, call deflection, automation rates)
	+ Monitor product performance and continuously iterate based on feedback and analytics
* Ensure delivery of measurable outcomes aligned to revenue and growth objectives
* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re\-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so

**Required Qualifications:**

* 13\+ years in healthcare services, healthcare technology, or software development
* 5\+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex, enterprise\-scale products
* 2\+ years Hands\-on experience delivering AI/ML\-driven products (e.g., LLMs, automation, decisioning systems)
* Experience translating strategy into execution (roadmaps, features, KPIs, delivery plans)
* Experience working in Agile environments and managing product backlogs
* Solid stakeholder management and communication skills, including executive\-level interaction
* Solid understanding of healthcare payer operations (claims, benefits, prior authorization, policy/editing)

 **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience using Microsoft Copilot
* Experience launching new AI products in the healthcare or payer space
* Experience working with external partners in product development
* Solid understanding of API\-first and platform product design
* Familiarity with agentic systems, orchestration frameworks, or platform\-based product models
* Demonstrated success supporting go\-to\-market strategy and product commercialization

 **Key Characteristics for Success**

* Solid blend of strategic thinking and execution rigor
* Ability to operate in ambiguity and rapidly evolving AI landscapes
* Customer\-centric mindset with deep understanding of payer operational pain points
* Data\-driven approach with focus on measurable business outcomes
* Collaborative leadership style with the ability to influence across teams

 *At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone\-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income\-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

* 3\-5 years of experience in software engineering.

* Familiarity with modern engineering tools and practices, including CI/CD and trunk\-based development.

* Readiness to work in a complex accounting domain, dealing with financial and investment\-related instruments.

An attractive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential components of any employment package. At SimCorp , we believe we can offer more. Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually **. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed.** At SimCorp , we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.


If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.


We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.  



**WHO WE ARE?**

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000\+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations , professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.


SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry\-leading, full, front\-to\-back offering for our clients.

**Company Description**
 eHealth Technologies is a leading healthcare technology company that advances the delivery of life\-altering care. Since 2006, we have decreased time to treatment for millions of patients and are trusted by the top healthcare systems, HIEs, and CROs throughout the United States.
   

  

 Our advanced technology and compassionate team expedites the collection, organization, and delivery of medical records, images, and pathology materials so that care teams have exactly what they need, where they need it, to get their patients back on the road to recovery as quickly as possible.
   

  

 Our team takes great pride in working behind the scenes for 70% of the top hospitals to help hundreds of thousands of patients every year.
   

  

**Career Opportunity Description**
 The Product Owner at eHealth Technologies operates as the CEO of the products they are assigned. They carry end\-to\-end accountability for the success of those products — not just for the delivery of features, but for the outcomes those products produce in the market, the experience customers have with them, and the commercial results they generate for the business. Where the product succeeds, the Product Owner is the person responsible; where it falls short, the Product Owner is the person who owns the gap and drives the fix.
   

  

 This role requires a whole product mindset. The software itself — the generic product — is only one component of what customers actually buy and adopt. The Product Owner is responsible for ensuring the whole product is in place: the core technology together with everything customers need to realize value from it, including documentation, training, onboarding, customer support readiness, sales enablement, implementation services, integrations, security and compliance posture, partner and vendor coordination, pricing and packaging, and the internal operational processes that surround delivery. When a gap in the whole product would undermine adoption, retention, or outcomes, the Product Owner is accountable for surfacing it and driving it to resolution — even when the work sits outside the engineering team.
   

  

 Acting as the voice of the customer and the steward of business value, this individual owns and prioritizes the product backlog, defines acceptance criteria, and drives alignment between stakeholders and development teams. In parallel, they manage sprint cadences, timelines, risks, and stakeholder communication to ensure high\-quality, on\-time delivery. They are accountable both for the right product being built and for the right conditions being in place around it for that product to succeed once delivered.
   

  

 This role is highly collaborative and customer\-facing, requiring strong communication, organization, follow\-through, and the executive judgment to make trade\-offs across competing demands.  performance.

 technical understanding.
 



 • Earn increasing autonomy in making decisions and driving strategic initiatives.
 



  





**Who You Are**

 • Able to balance technical constraints, customer needs, and business objectives.

**Overview**
 Microsoft Edge sits at the center of how users experience the web, Windows, and AI\-powered productivity. As the browser evolves from a productivity surface into an intelligent, AI\-first platform, we are extending the Edge charter forward—across core browser capabilities, AI experiences, Windows Copilot integration, and the underlying web platform (Chromium).
   

  

 We are seeking a Principal Product Manager who will play a defining role in shaping the long\-term product direction of Microsoft Edge. This role is about devising product shape, not just shipping features—setting vision, defining bets, influencing adjacent platforms, and ensuring that Edge continues to be a first\-class surface for users, developers, and the broader Windows \+ Copilot ecosystem.
   

  

 This is a senior, high\-impact role intended for product leaders who thrive in ambiguity, think at ecosystem scale, and are motivated by extending a charter rather than executing within fixed boundaries.
   

  

 The primary intent of this role is to extend the Edge charter forward.
   

  

**This Includes**
* Evolving Edge from a modern browser into an AI\-native application runtime.
* Defining how AI, Copilot, and browser primitives come together to unlock new user experiences.
* Influencing the future of the web platform and Chromium to better serve Edge, Windows, and Microsoft’s AI strategy.
* Shaping how Edge differentiates while remaining grounded in open web standards and ecosystem compatibility.


 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
   

  

 Starting January 26, 2026, Microsoft AI (MAI) employees who live within a 50\-mile commute of a designated Microsoft office in the U.S. or 25\-mile commute of a non\-U.S., country\-specific location are expected to work from the office at least four days per week. This expectation is subject to local law and may vary by jurisdiction.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 As a Principal Product Manager in Edge, you will:
   

  

 Product Strategy \& Vision
   

  

* Define the long\-term product shape and north star for Edge core capabilities, AI features in Edge, and deep Windows Copilot integration.
* Identify and frame high\-leverage problems where browsers, AI, and operating systems intersect, and turn them into clear product strategies.

 Web Platform \& Chromium Influence
   

  

* Act as a product voice for Microsoft within the Chromium ecosystem.
* Influence web platform direction to unlock future Edge and Windows scenarios.
* Balance open\-web principles with Edge\-specific differentiation and strategic advantage.


 Cross‑Org Leadership
   

  

* Work across highly diverse stakeholders: engineering, design, research, data science, Windows, Copilot, developer platform teams, legal, and privacy.
* Navigate ambiguity, negotiate tradeoffs, and align teams around shared outcomes without direct authority.
* Represent Edge product strategy in executive and cross\-company forums.


 Data‑Driven \& Customer‑Obsessed Execution
   

  

* Use data, user research, and experimentation to validate hypotheses and drive prioritization.

* Translate learning into scalable platform investments.

This senior position is responsible for ensuring high availability, security, and performance of Mattel’s global network environment, including wired, wireless, load balancing, and WAN services.

* **Certifications (Preferred):** CCNP, CCNA, F5 Certified Technology Specialist / Administrator, CWNP/CWNA, or equivalent.

**Additional Requirements**

* Deep understanding of TCP/IP, SDN concepts, Network Automation (Python/Ansible – added advantage), and security best practices.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, leadership, and communication skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively with global teams across time zones.
* Familiarity with **cloud networking concepts (AWS/Azure)** and hybrid network connectivity is an added advantage.
* Willingness to provide **24x5 weekend on\-call support** on a rotational basis.

 To Care for People on Life's Journey®. Together with our American Eagle regional partners, we offer thousands of flights daily to more than 350 destinations in more than 60 countries.

 This list is intended to reflect the current job but there may be additional essential functions (and certainly non\-essential job functions) that are not referenced. * Bachelor’s degree in related field plus 3 years of experience in Product Management/ Delivery (ex: product analyst, user researcher, product owner, etc.)

**Preferred Qualifications – Education \& Prior Job Experience:** 



* Experience determining Product Market fit and defining a Go\-to\-Market strategy
* Demonstrate familiarity with Agile Product Management tools

* Relevant certifications in Product Management/Product Delivery field

* Ability to effectively communicate both verbally and written with all levels within the organization
* Physical ability necessary to safely and successfully perform the essential functions of the position, with or without any legally required reasonable accommodations that do not pose an undue hardship.

HR (working with the operation) ordinarily first speaks with the team member directly and they mutually identify the physical demands of the job that are or may be impacted by the employee’s obvious or known condition. Then, if necessary, HR would request medical documentation from the team member’s treating physician or others to confirm the employee’s ability to perform those essential job functions safely and successfully.

jobs.title: Business Analyst, Amazon Business 3P
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Join Amazon Business 3P (Third Party \- Sellers) \- a rapidly growing global organization where we innovate at the intersection of AI technology and B2B commerce. We're reimagining how sellers reach and serve business customers, creating intelligent solutions that help them grow their B2B business on Amazon. From AI\-powered Seller Central tools to smart business certifications, dynamic pricing capabilities, and advanced analytics, we're transforming how B2B selling happens.  

  

We are looking for a tech savvy, data\-driven leader, willing to think big and invent \& simplify, as we continue to experiment with innovative ways to scale our growth. As a Business Analyst, you will have an opportunity to work on one of Amazon’s key strategic initiatives supporting businesses of all sizes, to help develop and innovate on the data architecture that will power some of the most scalable initiatives.  

  

We’re looking for an individual with excellent analytical abilities, knowledge of business intelligence solutions, business acumen, and the ability to work with quantitative and business teams. You will focus on the design and end\-to\-end execution of self\-service reporting, 3P Seller analytics, and data support for economic modeling. If you are passionate about data, go deep to find insights, relentless in ensuring data quality and reliability, and feel comfortable communicating with different levels of leadership, you are the candidate we are looking for!  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Lead analytical deep dives to investigate, identify and substantiate new business growth opportunities
* Build and deliver high quality customer and seller insights that will help understand and manage growth drivers of the business
* Build the business analyst roadmap and regularly review priorities with stakeholders
* Collaborate with engineering teams, data science, and partner BI teams to acquire new data from production systems or between databases. Explore ML and predictive models to improve the sophistication of our logic
* Continually improve ongoing reporting and analysis processes, automating or simplifying self\-service support for customers
* Write and present high\-quality written documents to various levels of leadership
* Work with Sales, Product, Marketing and Program teams to create inspection mechanisms to review and grow the business

  

About the team  

At Amazon Business, we strive to be the most recognized and preferred strategic partner for smart business buying. We stand at the intersection of technology and retail in the B2B space, developing innovative purchasing and procurement solutions to help businesses and organizations thrive. As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to bring your insight, imagination and healthy disregard for the impossible to build and celebrate the value of Amazon Business to buyers and sellers of all sizes and industries.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 1\+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
* 2\+ years of complex Excel VBA macros writing experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Experience defining requirements and using data and metrics to draw business insights
* Experience with SQL or ETL

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience working with Tableau
* Experience using very large datasets

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  

Data Analyst Job DescriptionPosition OverviewWe are seeking a detail\-oriented Data Analyst to join our team. The successful candidate will transform raw data into actionable insights that drive business decisions and strategy. This role requires strong analytical skills, proficiency with data tools, and the ability to communicate complex findings to diverse stakeholders.
  
**Key ResponsibilitiesData Analysis \& Reporting:** Collect, process, and analyze large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies. Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations that track key performance indicators. Conduct statistical analysis to support business initiatives and strategic planning.
  
**Business Intelligence:** Partner with cross\-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into analytical solutions. Provide data\-driven recommendations to improve operational efficiency, enhance decision\-making, and identify growth opportunities.
  
**Data Management:** Ensure data accuracy and integrity through validation and quality control processes. Design and maintain databases, data systems, and data collection procedures. Document analytical methodologies and create repeatable processes for routine reporting.
  
**Stakeholder Communication:** Present findings and insights to both technical and non\-technical audiences through clear visualizations and compelling narratives. Collaborate with department leaders to define success metrics and measurement frameworks.
  
**Required QualificationsEducation \& Experience:** Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, Business Analytics, or related field. 2\-4 years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or related role (adjust based on seniority level).
  
  

**Technical Skills:**  

Proficiency in SQL for data extraction and manipulation
  
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (pivot tables, VLOOKUP, formulas, macros)
  
Experience with data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, or similar)
  
Working knowledge of statistical analysis and programming languages (Python, R)
  
Understanding of database structures and data warehousing concepts
  
**Analytical Competencies:** Strong statistical and quantitative analysis skills with attention to detail. Ability to identify data quality issues and implement solutions. Critical thinking and problem\-solving capabilities with a results\-oriented mindset.
  
**Soft Skills:** Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to explain complex technical concepts to non\-technical audiences. Strong organizational skills with capacity to manage multiple projects simultaneously. Collaborative team player with ability to work independently.
  
Preferred QualificationsMaster's degree in a quantitative field
  
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
  
Knowledge of ETL processes and data integration tools
  
Familiarity with machine learning concepts
  
Industry\-specific experience (commercial real estate, finance, healthcare, etc.)
  
Certifications in relevant tools or methodologies
  
What We OfferCompetitive salary and benefits package
  
Professional development and training opportunities
  
Collaborative work environment
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  

Personalized benefits that support personal well\-being and growth:
  
  

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  

About JLL –
  
  

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  

Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  

Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

**Job Description**
**Job Purpose**
 ICE is seeking a Business Analyst to support the market surveillance technology used by its derivative exchanges. * Software product development, business analysis, quality assurance, or related experience highly preferable.
* Familiarity with Jira and Confluence preferable.

**Location:** 
 Hyderabad, India
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



  





  





**About the Role** 




 Divami is a Hyderabad\-based
 **Experience\-Led Decision Intelligenc** 
 e consulting company, 17 years, 200\+ enterprise clients across FinTech, BFSI, HealthTech, SaaS, Manufacturing, and Aerospace
 



 .We build the intelligence and experience layer that sits between enterprise systems and the humans who act on them\-making complex decisions feel human, fast, and trustworthy.
 *Our clients are CPOs, CTOs, and CDOs. Our work is structural, not decorative.* 




  





**The Opportunity** 




 Divami is growing fast. The complexity of running concurrent enterprise engagements across geographies is outpacing the informal systems that got us here. We need one person who can become the commercial and operational backbone of the business \- an Operating Partner to the Founder who sees across delivery, revenue, clients, and process simultaneously.
 



  





**This is not a coordinator rol** 
 e
 



 You will own Divami's P\&L visibility, client health, delivery infrastructure, and revenue forecast — with direct access to the founder from day one. The right person will have more operational authority here than they would after three years in a large consulting firm.
 



  





**Four Pillars of Ownership** 




**01 Analytical Skills** 




 Business analytics framework \- project health, utilization, delivery velocity. Decision\-ready dashboards for leadership: five numbers, every Monday. Monthly \& quarterly business reviews with interpreted signals, not raw data. Post\-project analyses: estimate vs. actuals, time lost, what gets systematized.
 



**02 Revenue Management** 




 Rolling 90\-day revenue forecast \- confirmed, probable, and pipeline. SOW and contract hygiene: scope creep flagged and priced before it's a write\-off. Billing\-to\-delivery gap tracking; per\-engagement P\&L presented to the founder monthly. Utilization monitoring \- under\-utilization (bench cost) and over\-utilization (burnout risk).One of the critical aspects of this category is about tracking the invoicing \- invoices sent, tracking receivables, following up with customers, stakeholder management etc.
 



**03 Sales Ops \& CRM** 




 Live client health tracker: sentiment, open items, escalation risk, renewal probability. QBR and steering committee cadence \- agenda, pre\-read, action tracker. Internal stakeholder alignment across design, tech, and strategy leads. pipeline review and management, commitment tracking. Relationship map for top\-10 accounts: decision\-makers, influencers, expansion potential.
 



**04 Vendor Management** 




 Vendor management, Legal \- including vendor contracts, customer contracts, regulatory \& compliance tracking/follow\-up. Not so much on the project management framework which is more on delivery management.
 



  





**What Success Looks Like** 



* **90 Days:** 
 Revenue forecast live and accurate to ±10%. Client health tracker operational. Delivery framework adopted by all leads. First QBR owned end\-to\-end.
* **6 Months:** 
 Per\-engagement P\&L visibility live. Capacity planning model running. First process improvement initiative shipped and measured. Escalation backlog at zero.
* **12 Months:** 
 Operations are self\-documenting. Onboarding time halved. Revenue recognition improved to 20%\+. Founder's time freed from ops fire\-fighting to strategy and growth.



**What You Bring** 




  




* Must\-Have MBA from IIM or equivalent premier institution (or demonstrably equivalent commercial sharpness from experience).
* 4\-8 years in business operations, delivery management, or management consulting \- with exposure to revenue / commercial accountability.
* Direct experience building reporting and forecasting systems \- not just reading them.
* Fluent at senior\-client interactions: QBRs, steering committees, founder\-level reviews.
* Proficient in Notion, Excel / Google Sheets; comfortable with data without needing an analyst.



  





**Strong Advantage** 




 Background in services, consulting, or design industry \- understands how a professional services P\&L works.
 



 Exposure to enterprise B2B clients: how CPOs, CTOs, and CDOs make decisions.
 



 Experience building operations or delivery infrastructure from scratch at a 50–300 person firm.
 



 Comfort with ambiguity \- has built processes where none existed, not improved ones that did.
 



 Finds Divami's positioning genuinely interesting. Curiosity about design, AI, and enterprise experience is a signal.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
###### **Before you read further**


You've personally built and shipped a product. Not managing a team that did it — you scoped it, designed it, got into the weeds with the model or the agent or the code, put it in front of real customers, and changed it based on what they did.


That's the qualifying condition for this role. Everything below is for people who clear that bar.


We don't think the next decade of enterprise software is won by a better roadmap. It's won by people who can see a vertical, build the product for it, sell it, price it, and own whether it makes money.

**More owner than employee**


At Lyzr, you operate like an owner, not a report line. The PMs who thrive here are former founders or future ones — that founder instinct is the mindset we're after.


A traditional PM does competitive analysis, manages the pipeline, coordinates engineering, runs the standup, and talks to customers when needed. All real work — and not enough for what we're building. A Lyzr PM does all of that and:

* Owns the P\&L. You're accountable for whether your vertical makes money, not just whether it ships.
* Owns the GTM. You understand the channel, the motion, the message, and you drive demand — you don't wait for marketing to "support the launch."
* Vibe\-codes the first cut. You're the first person to prototype, and do it yourself with real design sense — not a wireframe handed to engineering.
* Lives in the customer's world — has talked to at least 10 customers before a feature gets built.
* Thinks like an owner about growth. Product creativity and growth creativity are the same muscle to you.


You're not managing a roadmap. You're running a business inside Lyzr. We think of our PMs as partners who own the roadmap, the commercial outcome, and the future of the product.

 **What you'll own**

* A vertical, as a business. You'll own one of our agent categories — BFSI, Customer Support, Marketing, Sales Ops, Finance — end to end. ICP, use cases, outcomes, roadmap, pricing inputs, GTM, and the number at the bottom of it.
* The product surface. Vision, strategy, and positioning for your category, with an uncompromising focus on the outcome the customer actually buys — not the feature list.
* The first prototype — you build the v0 yourself, validate it with real users, then bring engineering in to scale what works.
* The customer relationship. Discovery, betas, value proofs, and selling. You'll be in front of customers and GSIs every week. You'll also be in the thumbs\-down comments and the support tickets when your agents misbehave.
* The evals and the guardrails. Quality bars for accuracy, latency, and cost; golden sets and pass/fail gates; policy and PII guardrails. You make the quality–latency–cost tradeoffs explicit and you own them.
* The commercial outcome. Adoption, activation, retention, expansion, win rate, and unit economics — token and model cost per task included. You know your numbers are cold.
* The go\-to\-market. Messaging, positioning, the competitive narrative, the launch, the one\-pager, the demo, the ROI story, and field/partner enablement. You don't hand this off.

###### **What you won't do here**

* Write quarterly roadmap PDFs to feel senior.
* Run a scrum and call it product management.
* Wait for engineering to ship before deciding what to ship next.
* Hand the GTM, pricing, or customer conversation to "the relevant team."

###### **What we're looking for**

* A builder's instinct. You turn an idea into a working product fast, validate it with customers, and iterate on what you learn. You don't wait for perfect requirements; you make the requirements by shipping.
* Real fluency in modern AI. LLMs, agent architectures, prompt and tool design, RAG, evals. You've built with these, not just read about them.
* Engineering\-grade debugging. When an agent is wrong, you read the logs, trace the tool call, check the grounding source, and write the regression test. You don't ask the team to "look into it."
* Design sense. You can tell good from bad, you have taste, and you're the final arbiter of whether an experience is something a customer would love or merely tolerate.
* Commercial judgment. You think in funnels, cohorts, and unit economics as naturally as in features. You can defend a pricing decision.
* Comfort with ambiguity. Priorities shift weekly, not every answer exists upfront, and that energizes rather than rattles you.
* The ability to influence without authority across technical and non\-technical teams, customers, and partners.

###### **Why Lyzr**

* Total ownership. You lead the projects, make the calls, and drive the impact.
* Work that matters. No busywork, no fluff — what you build here moves the needle and helps shape the future.
* Freedom to build. No micromanagement; just you, your ideas, and the green light to ship, scale, and make things happen.
* Global reach. You'll work with teams, partners, and customers across the globe — your ideas won't just stay local.

###### **The deal we're offering**

###### **Here's the honest version, because we think it's the most attractive thing about this role.**


We back builders with a budget and a team (engineering and marketing). You'll learn how enterprise actually works — how deals close, how value gets priced, how a category gets defined, how a Fortune 500 buyer thinks. We help you perfect your craft.


This is a founder residency disguised as a PM role. If you came to climb a ladder, you'll be disappointed. If you come to compress years of building into a much shorter window, this is the place.

NIKE, Inc. does more than outfit the world’s best athletes. It’s a place where passionate individuals come together to create the future of sport. We are unapologetic about who we are and what we’re after—bringing innovation and inspiration to every athlete\* in the world. WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH
  
  

You will report to the Senior Engineering and will be the technical leader for one of our data product squads. You will partner closely with Product Managers, Architects, BI Experience leads, and other engineering leads across Nike to define the strategy and roadmap for our consumption and ontology layers. You will mentor SWE I and SWE II engineers, raise the bar on engineering practices, and help our team reduce KLO/TCO while accelerating delivery.
  
  

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
  
  

We are looking for senior engineers who lead by example — engineers who write excellent code, drive crisp design discussions, and grow the people around them.
  
  

A minimum of 7–10 years of backend and/or data engineering experience.
  
  

Deep expertise in at least one of Java, Python, or Scala, and strong fluency in SQL and data modeling.
  
  

Proven experience designing distributed systems and data products — microservices, REST/GraphQL APIs, event\-driven architectures, batch and streaming pipelines.
  
  

Hands\-on experience with Databricks, Spark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog (or equivalent), and orchestration tools such as Airflow.
  
  

Strong cloud experience (AWS, GCP, or Azure) including networking, IAM, secrets, and cost\-aware architecture.
  
  

Demonstrated ability to lead technical design reviews, define APIs and data contracts, and drive consensus across teams.
  
  

Track record of mentoring engineers — code reviews, design coaching, career growth conversations.
  
  

**Experience with observability and SRE practices:** metrics, tracing, alerting, error budgets, on\-call leadership.
  
  

Comfortable with TDD, modern CI/CD, and the productive use of AI engineering tools (GitHub Copilot, etc.).
  
  

Strong written and verbal communication — able to influence both engineers and senior business stakeholders.
  
  

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field — or equivalent experience.
  
  

**Preferred:** experience with data governance, RLS/ABAC, ontology/semantic layers, dbt, agentic/LLM\-powered analytics layers, or large\-scale BI platforms.
  
  

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON
  
  

As a Lead Software Engineer in Marketplace Data Engineering, you will own the technical direction of a data product squad serving Nike Direct, Wholesale Demand, Inventory, 3PP Demand, Customer Dimensional data, WFM, Clickstream, Member, or Orderbook.
  
  

You will lead the design of consumption layers, APIs, and pipelines that BI Experience teams build on — establishing patterns, contracts, and quality bars.
  
  

You will drive aggressive simplification and unification of our data products landscape, reducing KLO/TCO while improving consistency.
  
  

You will co\-create agentic and ontology\-driven consumption experiences with BI Experience teams, embedding business context and metric consistency directly into our code and systems.
  
  

You will own production reliability, scalability, and security for your squad's services — leading incident response, capacity planning, and the operational quality of what you ship.
  
  

You will mentor and grow the SWE I and SWE II engineers on the squad, raising the technical bar through reviews, pairing, and design coaching.
  
  

You will partner with the Platform team to adopt and contribute back recommended toolkits, blueprints, and patterns.
  
  

You will represent the team in cross\-org architecture forums and influence the broader Nike data architecture.

No matter the location, or the role, every Nike employee shares one galvanizing mission: To bring inspiration and innovation to every athlete\* in the world.
  
  

NIKE, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability.

OUR HIRING GAME PLAN
  
01 Apply

 The Product team forms the crux of our powerful platforms and helps connect millions of customers worldwide with the brands that matter most to them.  Epsilon PeopleCloud is trusted by the world’s leading brands to activate data\-driven marketing at scale. Our CDP and Clean Room capabilities enable marketers to build precise, privacy\-safe audiences across every channel.
 



 As the landscape evolves, measurement has emerged as the next frontier. Marketers today face a compounding challenge: fragmented attribution across email, paid social, and owned channels, all competing to claim credit for the same sale. This inhibits the marketer’s ability to understand true campaign effectiveness. This is the problem you’ll be chartered to solve. You'll own and drive the cross\-channel measurement \& attribution workstream within the Epsilon PeopleCloud CDP \& Clean Room product portfolio.
 



  





 Click here to view how Epsilon transforms marketing with 1 View, 1 Vision and 1 Voice.

* Drive alignment across Epsilon India and global partners on prioritization, trade\-offs, and delivery milestones.
* Define success metrics for the attribution workstream and own progress communication to leadership.
* Stay current on the attribution and measurement ecosystem.



  





 Qualifications
 



  





 What We’re Looking For
 



  





 Required:
 


* 5–7 years of Product Management experience, with meaningful exposure to MarTech, AdTech, or CDP platforms.

* Strong understanding of agile development methodologies and principles, with experience scaling these methodologies in a geographically distributed team.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; able to distill ambiguous, technically complex problems into crisp narratives for executive and cross\-functional audiences.

* Hands\-on with AI tools for PM workflows for research, synthesis, writing, and prototyping.



 Preferred:
 


* Prior experience with measurement or attribution products, clean rooms, or identity resolution platforms.
* Familiarity with privacy\-safe measurement and attribution frameworks.
* Experience working in a global product org with India\-based delivery and US/EU stakeholders

 Microsoft AI is a customer\-first organization building AI powered products in service of our customer’s business goals. The world is changing rapidly during this AI platform shift and we need Product Managers who can live in the future and bring back clarity to the present to guide our work.
   

  

**Role**
 As a
 **Principal Product Manager** 
 for Microsoft AI, you will help businesses that want to grow and expand their business using our products, data, and services through advertising and new business models that unlock AI\-first products. This role requires consistent knowledge and deep awareness of the emerging AI industry to develop new products as we have the freedom and flexibility to use the best technology in service of our customer. You will be part of Microsoft AI Monetization Platform trust and safety team to ensure all the products we build are safe and trustworthy. This is an opportunity to lead a critical area of Trust, shaping the future of ads integrity, anticipating emerging abuse vectors, including synthetic media and other sophisticated agentic attacks. The ideal candidate for role:
   

  

* Has Trust, Safety, Integrity or Fraud Prevention expertise, with a track record of building platform\-level safety, moderation, or abuse\-prevention solutions.
* Can drive multi\-year, high\-impact strategies, ensuring measurable improvements to developer efficiency and defense agility.
* Operates with autonomy and influence, leading large\-scale, cross\-organizational initiatives and has a track record of influencing organizational change.
* Excels at navigating complex cross\-org dynamics, balancing business, policy, and technical constraints to ensure safety at scale.
* Helps us raise the bar for the Product Management craft by mentoring senior PMs and fostering a culture of product excellence and user\-first thinking.


 We work within Microsoft AI (MAI), an organization responsible for Copilot, Bing, Edge, MSN, and other AI\-first products. The organization has all the ingredients needed for success with Product, Engineering, Research, and Go To Market functions partnering as peers with shared goals. This enables close collaboration and rapid decision making.
   

  

 One of the reasons Microsoft AI consistently brings innovative products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. We work closely with talented engineers, designers, marketers, creatives, customers, partners, and go\-to\-market teams to design and develop products tailored for our customer’s benefit. We run lean, obsess about users, and make decisions based on evidence. We ship regularly, so your work will have real and immediate impact. It’s a time of huge change in the AI landscape, and this role will put you right in the heart of it.
   

  

 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
   

  

 Starting January 26, 2026, Microsoft AI (MAI) employees who live within a 50\- mile commute of a designated Microsoft office in the U.S. or 25\-mile commute of a non\-U.S., country\-specific location are expected to work from the office at least four days per week. This expectation is subject to local law and may vary by jurisdiction.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Itron is innovating new ways for utilities and cities to manage energy and water. We create a more resourceful world to protect essential resources for today and tomorrow. Join us.
   

  

**Itron** 
 is a global technology company. We build solutions that help utilities measure, manage and analyze energy and water. Our broad product portfolio includes electricity, gas, water and thermal energy measurement and control technology; communications systems; software; and professional services. With thousands of employees supporting nearly 8,000 utilities in more than 100 countries, Itron empowers utilities to responsibly and efficiently manage energy and water resources. Join us in creating a more resourceful world.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We're hiring a Product Manager III to join Itron's EP\&R (Emergency Preparedness and Response) product team, based in our Bangalore office. EP\&R is one of Itron's most critical solutions, helping utilities plan for and respond to severe weather events and large\-scale outages.
   

  

 You'll report to our Lead PM and partner closely with engineering teams in Bangalore and Thailand. The role is intentionally placed in Bangalore for time zone alignment and collaboration with both teams. As a core member of EP\&R product \- your primary focus will be our
 **Storm Manager** 
 ,
 **Storm Impact** 
 , and
 **Callout** 
 applications, with opportunities to contribute to platform initiatives as we build more horizontal capabilities across EP\&R and adjacent product lines.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Drive the roadmap for Storm Manager, Storm Impact, and Callout. Prioritize the backlog, plan releases, and align delivery to company goals.
* Drive discovery. Interview customers, partner with internal SMEs, and validate solutions through experimentation before committing engineering capacity.
* Prototype to learn faster. Use AI\-assisted tools (Claude, Cursor, Replit, Figma Make etc.) to mockup flows, test ideas with customers, and de\-risk decisions before they hit a sprint.
* Translate problems into shippable solutions. Write clear user stories, use cases, and acceptance criteria that engineering and design can execute without ambiguity.
* Operate cross\-functionally across BLR, Thailand, and US\-based PM, engineering, design, and implementation teams. You won't have direct reports; your influence comes from clarity and follow\-through.
* Measure what ships. Track adoption, outcomes, and customer feedback. Adjust direction based on evidence, not opinion.
* Contribute to platform thinking. As we scale horizontal solutions across EP\&R, help identify capabilities that should live at the platform layer vs. the product layer.
* Stakeholder Communication. Own the communication rythm around roadmap progress, release milestones, and key decisions proactively surfacing risks and trade\-offs so leadership can make informed business decisions.
* 5\+ years in product management, with at least part of that in vertical B2B SaaS serving enterprise customers. (Required)


**Customer\-fluent.** 
 You're comfortable in the room with utility operations teams and can translate operational workflows into scalable solutions.
   

  

**Technically credible.** 
 You don't write production code, but you can hold your own on architecture, integrations, data flows, and modern AI/ML concepts with engineering.
   

  

**Hands\-on with AI tooling.** 
 You actively use AI coding and prototyping tools as part of your PM workflow — to draft specs, build clickable prototypes, query data, and accelerate discovery. You treat these as leverage, not novelty.
   

  

**Sharp writer.** 
 Your PRDs leave little room for interpretation. You can also defend a decision to a skeptical exec in three sentences.
   

  

**Organized under pressure.** 
 You keep dependencies visible and priorities tight across distributed teams without becoming a bottleneck.
   

  

**Adaptable.** 
 You operate well in a fast\-paced environment where scope shifts and processes are still being built.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
 Bachelor's degree in a technology\-related field, or equivalent experience.
   

  

 Domain experience in utility operations, outage management, storm/weather modeling, or field operations.
   

  

 Experience working on or with platform teams supporting multiple product lines.
   

  

 Experience shipping functional prototypes or internal tools yourself using AI\-Assisted tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Replit, etc.) — bonus if you've used them to validate a feature pre\-engineering.
   

  

 Experience integrating with third\-party enterprise systems
   

  

 Track record shipping enterprise applications used in both field and office environments.
   

  

 Willingness to travel to the US and Thailand for customer visits and team offsites.
   

  

 Itron is committed to building an inclusive and diverse workforce and providing an authentic workplace experience for all employees. If you are excited about this role but your past experiences don't perfectly align with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. In the end, you may be just who we are looking for!
   

  

 The successful candidate's starting wage will be determined based on permissible, non\-discriminatory factors such as skills and experience.
   

  

 Itron is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you require an accommodation to apply, please contact a recruiting representative at 1\-800\-635\-5461 or email Accessibility@itron.com.
   

  

 Itron is transforming how the world manages energy, water and city services. Our trusted intelligent infrastructure solutions help utilities and cities improve efficiency, build resilience and deliver safe, reliable and affordable service. With edge intelligence, we connect people, data insights and devices so communities can better manage the essential resources they rely on to live. Join us as we create a more resourceful world: www.itron.com

jobs.description:
**Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human**  

  

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real\-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.  

  

This is an opportunity to do career\-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

**The Overview**



At Okta, we're building a world where anyone can safely use any technology, and we're specifically focused on protecting the future of work. We bring simple and secure access to people and organizations everywhere, promising to not only protect the identities of our customers' workforce and users but to ask, “what more can we make possible?”



As a Staff Product Designer for Okta, you’ll work with a globally distributed design team to apply your craft and expertise on a range of products and services. Our culture provides the opportunity to explore the technologies we’re researching and investing in. Some of your work will be functional, practical user experience design, where you will help our design team drive cohesive user experience across Okta’s portfolio of products. Other work will be speculative, generative explorations that you carry out in collaboration and partnership across the organization to flesh out, frame, and help prioritize solutions in an ever\-evolving and complex, often ambiguous, problem space.

* You have experience leading cross\-discipline teams and exemplify leadership.
* You are passionate about solving complex problems, crafting and sharing product and design UX principles to help teams deliver cohesive user experiences.
* You are great at collaborating, sharing work early and often, and seeking constructive feedback from peers and stakeholders.

Leadership \& Collaboration

jobs.description:
P\-1563


At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. Founded by engineers — and customer obsessed — we leap at every opportunity to solve technical challenges, from designing next\-gen UI/UX for interfacing with data to scaling our services and infrastructure across millions of virtual machines. And we're only getting started in **Bengaluru , India** ! As a software engineer with a backend focus, you will work with your team to build infrastructure for the Databricks platform at scale.


**About the Team**


We manage the infrastructure efficiency for one of the world's largest data and AI platforms. Operating at massive scale across AWS, Azure, and GCP, our mission is to ensure that every dollar spent on cloud infrastructure is optimized. The MCE team builds the critical tools, frameworks, and automated systems that provide deep cost visibility and ensure maximum resource utilization. We are looking for engineers to help us engineer systems that optimize our footprint as we scale into the hundreds of millions of dollars in cloud spend.


**The Role**


As a Senior Software Engineer, you will own the end\-to\-end design and delivery of high\-impact engineering projects. You will act as a primary owner of key system components, handling technical ambiguity, collaborating with stakeholders, and delivering robust, scalable solutions. Your work will directly impact our infrastructure margins by building the next generation of cost attribution, automated resource management, and efficiency tooling.


**The impact you will have**


* **End\-to\-End System Design**: Lead projects from concept to deployment. You will design and build scalable systems that handle high\-volume data streams to provide accurate cost attribution and resource management, turning chaotic cloud spend into actionable data.
* **Scaling \& Optimization**: Identify and eliminate inefficiencies in our cloud architecture. You will engineer solutions that mitigate resource waste, improve attribution accuracy, and raise the efficiency of our underlying cloud and data infrastructure.
* **Component Ownership**: Act as the technical expert for your service area. You will take ownership of the full lifecycle of your services, ensuring high code quality, effective monitoring, and low operational overhead.
* **Bridge the Gap**: Work effectively with product and infrastructure teams to turn business needs into technical specifications. You will develop tooling that simplifies the complex world of cloud economics for other engineers and budget owners.
* **Mentorship \& Best Practices**: Uplevel the team by contributing to code reviews, sharing engineering best practices, and mentoring junior engineers. You will drive a shift\-left culture — catching cost and efficiency problems early in the development cycle — by integrating efficiency checks directly into the developer workflow.
* **Automate the manual:** Build the automation and AI/agentic tooling that detects waste, attributes cost, and remediates issues with minimal human intervention — turning repetitive cost operations into self\-running systems.

**What We Look For**


* 6\+ years of experience, including producing high\-quality production code and detailed technical design documents for distributed systems.
* Proven ability to break down complex, multi\-month projects into actionable milestones and tasks.
* Solid grasp of industry best practices for distributed systems (monitoring, documentation, testing, and "fit and finish").
* Experience in optimizing cloud resource utilization or developing large\-scale distributed tools.
* Ability to make well\-reasoned trade\-offs between system performance, development velocity, and technical debt.

**Introduction: A Career at HARMAN Automotive**


We’re a global, multi\-disciplinary team that’s putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. At HARMAN Automotive, we give you the keys to fast\-track your career.

* Engineer audio systems and integrated technology platforms that augment the driving experience
* Combine ingenuity, in\-depth research, and a spirit of collaboration with design and engineering excellence
* Advance in\-vehicle infotainment, safety, efficiency, and enjoyment

**About the Role**


As an Embedded Automotive Data Architect, you will design and lead the in\-vehicle data collection architecture that enables continuous improvement and personalization of in\-vehicle audio experiences, while ensuring a secure, privacy\-preserving approach. You will partner closely with ML Engineers, Data Engineers, and Intelligent Cockpit engineers to define and roll out an end\-to\-end architecture that supports OTA delivery of edge AI/ML model updates, fully aligned with OEM specifications, constraints, and requirements. You will bridge collaboration with Intelligent Cockpit and Central Compute (HU/CCU) development teams to expand logging, telemetry, and communication mechanisms to capture and export audio system related interactions events and user preference data to enable continuous improvement of machine learning models and next\-generation audio features.

**What You Will Do**

* Partner with Intelligent Cockpit and Central Compute (HU/CCU), Data Engineer and ML to design and roll out architecture for data collection and models updates.
* Identify HMI/UX interaction and communication messages in HU/CCU/Amplifier to reliably capture how users interact with audio features.
* Identify logging mechanisms and storage allocation on HU/CCU/Amplifier to store relevant audio system related interactions and user preferences.
* Define retention, compression, and resource budgeting (CPU/RAM/flash) for new messages and signals about audio features usage and user preferences
* Architect data upload mechanisms, both on board and by cellphone gateways, under real constraints: connectivity availability, restrictions, cost/bandwidth budgets, OEM policies, intermittent coverage, and offline\-first behavior; implement batching, sampling, retry/acknowledgement for data Collection retrieval.
* Identify and establish secure OTA workflows to update ML models considering versioning, integrity checks, rollout and rollback strategies, and compatibility rules.
* Advise in\-vehicle OS integration approach across HU/CCU platforms (Linux, Android Automotive, QNX, and other OEM stacks) about logging frameworks, networking messaging and UDS.
* Select and advise on vehicle networking messages (CAN / Automotive Ethernet, etc.) to safely consume necessary signals and create correlation with Audio systems events.
* Advise on privacy mechanisms including data minimization, anonymization, retention and deletion rules for data collection
* Advise on consent\-aware data collection, retention and deletion strategies according to privacy standards and OEM practices.
* Partner with Data/ML/DSP teams to ensure the vehicle\-side data architecture cleanly connects to cloud pipelines for training, evaluation, and continuous improvement of edge experiences.

**What You Need to Be Successful**

* 12\+ years of experience in automotive embedded software or systems engineering, with architecture ownership in at least one of: Head Unit/Infotainment, Cockpit/Domain Controller, Telematics/Connectivity, or Vehicle Data/Diagnostics.
* Experience designing telemetry/logging systems under constrained compute/memory/storage, including reliability strategies (buffering, persistence, loss management).
* Experience with OTA update architectures (software/component delivery), including artifact versioning, signing/integrity, staged rollout, rollback, and compatibility management.
* Working knowledge of HU/CCU operating systems (Linux, Android Automotive, QNX, or similar), including debugging/log analysis, process/service design, and performance constraints.
* Solid knowledge of automotive networking and integration constraints: CAN, Automotive Ethernet, UDS and ODB\-II and ability to collaborate with cybersecurity stakeholders.
* Strong communication, collaboration and leadership skills to influence cross\-functional stakeholders and standardize practices across teams.
* Strong structured mindset with the ability to design complex and robust systems while keeping optimal and clean architecture

**Bonus Points if You Have**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, or Computer Science (or closely related field).
* Experience with SDV and zonal vehicle architecture
* Experience with Android Automotive, QNX, embedded Linux distributions used in cockpit systems, or OEM\-specific stacks.
* Familiarity with common automotive diagnostics patterns and tools (e.g., DTC workflows, log/trace pipelines).
* Background in infotainment/audio feature delivery, real\-time constraints, or resource budgeting for DSP/SoC platforms.
* Exposure to cybersecurity and automotive standards contexts (e.g., ISO 21434\) and/or process frameworks (ASPICE), even if not the owner.
* Understanding of privacy and security fundamentals for connected data systems (data minimization, consent, pseudonymization, encryption, secure communications)

**What Makes You Eligible**

* Advanced English communication skill, will be part of a Global team
* Willing to work in an office at Bangalore.

**What We Offer**

* Flexible work environment, allowing for full\-time remote work globally for positions that can be performed outside a HARMAN or customer location

jobs.description:
**About Rupeek:**




**Rupeek** 
 , established in 2015 and headquartered in Bangalore, stands as India's leading asset\-backed digital lending fintech platform. Committed to making credit accessible to Indians in a fair and convenient manner, Rupeek pioneers innovative financial products focused on monetizing India's $2 trillion gold market. Leveraging state\-of\-the\-art technology and an automated asset\-light supply chain, Rupeek is transforming the gold loan disbursal landscape across 40\+ cities in India. With a customer base exceeding 5,00,000\+, the company's strategic partnerships with top banks and financial institutions underscore its commitment to building gold\-backed assets through low\-risk, low\-touch, and friction\-free processes.
 



 Rupeek's impressive journey is supported by key investors such as Sequoia Capital, Accel Partners, Bertelsmann, and GGV Capital.
 ***In Apr 2024, Rupeek turned profitable and raised* 
 $25
 *in equity capital from Manipal Group and Elevation Capital to fund its next phase of growth* 
 .** 
 Join us in redefining the future of finance through innovation, technology, and a commitment to financial inclusivity.
 



  





**About the Role:**




 We are looking for a highly analytical and driven Business Analyst to monitor, analyze, and optimize business funnels across cities and channels. This role requires strong problem\-solving skills, a data\-driven mindset, and the ability to work closely with cross\-functional teams to drive business impact.
 



  





**Job title:** 
 Analyst \- Product \& Strategy
 



**Education:** 
 B.Tech from reputed top\-tier colleges, with preference for IIT/BITS/top NITs
 



**Experience:** 
 1\-3 years of relevant experience
 



**Location:** 
 Bangalore

* Analyze conversion funnels, identify performance deviations, and generate actionable recommendations for optimization

* Partner with product, business, and cross\-functional stakeholders to design and implement strategic initiatives
* Extract insights from customer interactions, feedback, and operational data to identify pain points and root causes
* Structure ambiguous business problems into data\-driven frameworks and actionable solutions in a fast\-paced environment
* Define, track, and report key KPIs to support product strategy, experimentation, and business decision\-making

* Be part of a fast\-growing fintech shaping the future of credit in India

jobs.description:
Position Description
   

  

 Founded in 1976, CGI is among the largest independent IT and business consulting services firms in the world. With 94,000 consultants and professionals across the globe, CGI delivers an end\-to\-end portfolio of capabilities, from strategic IT and business consulting to systems integration, managed IT and business process services and intellectual property solutions. CGI works with clients through a local relationship model complemented by a global delivery network that helps clients digitally transform their organizations and accelerate results. CGI Fiscal 2024 reported revenue is CA$14\.68 billion and CGI shares are listed on the TSX (GIB.A) and the NYSE (GIB). Learn more at cgi.com.
   

  

 Job Title: SE/SSE
   

  

 Position: Workday Business Application Analyst
   

  

 Experience: 4\- 7 Years
   

  

 Category: Software Development/ Engineering
   

  

 Shift: 1\.00 PM\-10\.00 PM
   

  

 Mode :5 Days WFO
   

  

 Main location: Bangalore
   

  

 Education Qualification: Bachelor's degree in computer science or related field or higher with minimum 3 years of relevant experience.
   

  

 Position Description: We’re looking for a Workday Business Application Analyst to join our team in Bangalore
   

  

 Your future duties and responsibilities
   

  

 Roles \& Responsibilities – Workday Payroll Consultant
   

  

 Configure and support Workday Payroll modules for US and Canada, including earnings, deductions, taxes, retro calculations, payroll processing, and payroll\-related business processes.
   

  

 Perform end\-to\-end payroll processing activities, including validation, reconciliation, troubleshooting payroll discrepancies, and ensuring timely payroll completion.
   

  

 Analyze and resolve payroll production issues, employee pay discrepancies, tax\-related issues, and retroactive payroll adjustments.
   

  

 Execute and manage EIB (Enterprise Interface Builder) loads ranging from simple to complex data uploads and corrections.
   

  

 Monitor, troubleshoot, and support payroll integrations with upstream and downstream vendor systems, ensuring seamless data flow and issue resolution.
   

  

 Handle day\-to\-day ticket and inbox management activities using tools such as Jira and ServiceNow while adhering to SLA timelines.
   

  

 Create, manage, and track user stories, defects, enhancements, and tasks in Agile project environments using Jira.
   

  

 Develop, customize, and maintain Workday standard and custom reports to support payroll operations, audits, reconciliations, and business reporting needs.
   

  

 Collaborate with HR, Payroll, Finance, IT, and external vendors to gather requirements, provide functional solutions, and ensure smooth payroll operations.
   

  

 Support payroll compliance activities for US and Canadian payroll regulations, tax updates, and statutory requirements.
   

  

 Work closely with Time Tracking and Absence Management teams to ensure accurate payroll inputs and integration alignment.
   

  

 Participate in Agile Pod ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog grooming, stand\-ups, testing, and release activities.
   

  

 Perform root cause analysis for recurring payroll and integration issues and recommend process improvements and automation opportunities.
   

  

 Support testing activities including unit testing, regression testing, parallel payroll testing, and UAT for payroll enhancements and releases.
   

  

 Maintain process documentation, knowledge articles, SOPs, and configuration documents related to payroll operations and support activities.
   

  

**Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role**
 Must Have:
   

  

 Minimum of 3–5 years of hands\-on experience performing the following tasks in Workday:
   

  

* Workday Payroll configuration and support (US \& Canada: earnings, deductions, taxes, retro, payroll processing)
* Payroll processing support, troubleshooting issues, and reconciliation of payrolls.
* Executing EIB loads (simple to complex)
* Monitoring and troubleshooting payroll integrations (upstream/downstream vendors)
* Inbox/ticket management (JIRA, ServiceNow)
* Creating and managing Stories/tasks in JIRA
* Developing and maintaining Workday reports (standard and custom)


 Nice to Have:
   

  

* Workday Payroll certification
* Understanding of Workday Time Tracking and Absence Management and how this connects to payroll.
* Experience with US and Canadian payroll compliance
* Stakeholder management (HR, Payroll, IT)
* Experience working in Agile Pods

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**
 Serve as a business analyst within a hybrid work model translating complex business needs into scalable digital solutions using SQL Java Springboot microservices JavaScript PL or SQL on mySQL and AWS services. Collaborate with cross functional stakeholders to deliver secure reliable and efficient applications that advance enterprise goals and create meaningful value for end users.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Analyze business processes and requirements in detail to define clear functional and nonfunctional specifications that guide design of scalable solutions using SQL Java and microservice patterns on Springboot and AWS services.
* Collaborate with product owners and business stakeholders to prioritize backlogs refine user stories and acceptance criteria and ensure that each increment delivers measurable value to customers and the organization.
* Document end to end process flows data mappings and system interaction diagrams that clearly explain how PL or SQL on mySQL Java services JavaScript front ends and AWS components work together to support business outcomes.
* Coordinate with engineering teams to translate requirements into technical tasks clarify edge cases and validate that database logic Java and JavaScript implementations align with expected behavior and performance goals.
* Perform detailed data analysis using SQL and PL or SQL on mySQL to identify patterns validate data quality support decision making and proactively highlight data related risks or gaps in existing solutions.
* Support design and review of Springboot microservices by defining interface contracts payload structures and error handling scenarios that improve interoperability resilience and maintainability.
* Work closely with quality engineering teams to define test strategies create test scenarios based on user journeys and verify that functional behavior integrations and data transformations meet requirements.
* Facilitate workshops and walkthroughs with cross functional partners to present solution options explain technical trade offs in accessible terms and secure alignment on chosen approaches and delivery timelines.
* Use AWS capabilities such as managed databases messaging and compute services in collaboration with architects to propose solution patterns that improve scalability security and cost effectiveness for business services.
* Prepare clear user documentation release notes and training material that help business teams adopt new features quickly and reduce dependency on technical teams for routine operational queries.
* Monitor production issues and incident trends in partnership with support teams analyze root causes in microservices SQL logic or JavaScript flows and recommend backlog items that strengthen stability and user satisfaction.
* Apply structured delivery practices and agile ceremonies within the hybrid work model by planning sprints tracking progress and maintaining transparent communication channels with on site and remote stakeholders.
* Contribute to continuous improvement by recommending data driven enhancements automation opportunities and reusable solution patterns that advance the company technology strategy and deliver positive impact for society.


**Qualifications**
* Demonstrate strong proficiency in SQL and PL or SQL on mySQL with the ability to design queries optimize performance and interpret complex data sets to support analytical and transactional use cases.
* Bring hands on experience in Java and Springboot based microservices including design of REST interfaces integration patterns and application of secure coding and modular design principles.
* Possess solid practical knowledge of JavaScript for user interface interactions validation logic and integration with backend services in modern web applications.
* Show proven exposure to AWS cloud services relevant to application hosting data storage and messaging while understanding shared responsibility concepts and cost aware design considerations.
* Exhibit six to nine years of experience as a business analyst or similar role in technology driven environments with a track record of converting business goals into actionable technical requirements.
* Communicate effectively with both technical and business audiences using clear language structured documentation and collaborative problem solving approaches within diverse teams in a hybrid work setup.
